snippet.description:
Springs, Eternal is coming to PC on November 11, and you can play the demo RIGHT NOW. https://store.steampowered.com/app/3677850/Springs_Eternal/

Step into the magical realist world of Stillwater Springs and start getting to know the cast of characters that have been drawn to this mysterious place. Wishlist today, and play the full game on 11/11/26! https://springsetern.al
